judgments.evidence: Textbook fact the code doesn't compute: the tracker takes K_fbk from outside (src/library.jl:2905, docstring 'The gains are designed outside'). Probe K6d_v/probe.jl:201-206 solves the CARE for tracker_plant with Q = R = I by the Hamiltonian method. The residual is 3.1e-16 and the eigenvalues of A - BK are -1.98 +/- 0.66i, so the closed loop is stable (out.txt:38).

src/library.jl:2923 implements u_raw = u_trim + K_fwd (z_ref - z_trim) - K_fbk (x - x_trim) + q. Probe out.txt:33 computes M22 + K M12 for tracker_plant and gets [1 -1; 2 4], which equals the fixture's K_fwd. With these gains the plain loop settles on the target [1.0, 0.5] (out.txt:34).

Probe out.txt:37 shows the linearized closed-loop A (plant and q taps) is the same with and without the disturbance [0.2, -0.1]. At t = 200, out.txt:35 has the plant at z = z_ref and q at [-0.2, 0.1], which balances w. The test test/test_library.jl:3434 agrees.

src/library.jl:2923 and 3053 add q directly, and only the integrator input carries K_int (2928, 3059). Probe out.txt:32 steps a scheduled K_int tenfold at t = 1. The per-tick change of u_raw at frames 98 to 101 is 0.0079, 0.0079, 0.0135, 0.0128: the accumulation rate changes and the command does not jump.

src/library.jl:2928 and 3059 feed gated_error the vector K_int (z_ref - z), at NU width. gated_error (2343-2344) and correction_reference (2351-2352) select per channel with broadcast ifelse. Probe out.txt:20-24: channel 1 limited and channel 2 free give different per-channel results.

src/library.jl:2350 makes v the reference at every code when there is no hold: correction_reference(::AbstractAntiWindupController{false, true}) = u.v. Only with the hold does a free channel fall back to its own u (2351-2352). Probe out.txt:22: with hold = false and tracking = true, channel 2's derivative reads (v - u_raw)/Tt = 8.85, not (u - u_raw)/Tt. The companion's bullet states the hold-and-tracking rule as tracking's general rule.
judgments.fix: - **tracking** adds the input `v`, an `SVector{NU, Float64}`, as the correction's reference: without the hold in every channel, and with it while a channel is limited or not engaged, with the fallback to the own `u` while it is free.
judgments.note: D-385's second ruling records the no-hold row ('Without the hold inputs the error passes and the reference is v where the block tracks'). Commit 17ad42da added the same qualifier to section 7's wiring sentence ('since without one v is the reference at every code') but missed this bullet.
